# Appendix 3 {#sec-appendix-3}

![Standard Normal Table](images/appendix3/stdz.svg){#fig-zscoretable}   

--  


```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: tbl-ztable
#| tbl-cap: "Standard Normal Table: entries give the area under the standard normal curve to the left of z."
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

dt <- read.csv("csv/ztable.csv", check.names = FALSE)
colnames(dt)[1] <- "z"

kbl(dt, escape = FALSE, booktabs = FALSE, align = "c") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = F, html_font = "Consolas") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"),
                bootstrap_options = c("bordered"),
                font_size = 11) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```
